Alex Chen: Quick heads-up — APAC cluster (shelf-3) scheduled cooling maintenance 2025-07-22 02:00 UTC -> 2025-07-24 02:00 UTC. Expect ~-20% GPU capacity in ap-southeast for ~48h. Need to update Q3 GPU-hour forecast and packing policy; pinging infra for mitigations.
Priya Singh: Noted. Do we have exact node IDs and start time?
Alex Chen: Start 2025-07-22 02:00 UTC. Affected nodes: gpunode-ap-s-03[01..24] (~24 GPUs total).
Marcos Alvarez: Rough quick math — that's ~24 gpus * 48h = 1152 GPU-hours lost, but at 16x cards per host it maps to ~18432 GPU-hours of scheduled work if we count tenant slots; will run binpack sim to be precise.
Marcos Alvarez: Quick sim output:
```
sim: binpack_v2 --reserve 0.12 --max_squeeze 0.7
lost_hours=18432
p99_latency_delta=+12ms
fallback_rate=3.6%
```
Nikhil Rao: Can we borrow reserved Dedicated capacity from NA for the window? How many slots to keep SLAs?
Priya Singh: We need ~6 80GB GPUs reserved to keep throughput invariant — that's 6 * 48h = 288 GPU-hours of reserved capacity. Cross-region routing will add ~20-40ms depending on client location.
Jamie Lee: Any high-commit customers in APAC this week impacted?
Alex Chen: Two Dedicated customers with heavy APAC usage (cust-phi, cust-zen). We'll need to notify them and offer temporary credits or routing changes.
deploy-bot: autoscaler:policy: canary patch applied to apac pool (relax_binpack=true) :white_check_mark:
Marcos Alvarez: Simulation suggests an option: reduce packing aggressiveness from 0.85 -> 0.75. That reduces fragmentation loss (lost_hours down ~30%) but increases per-token unit cost ~+6%.
Priya Singh: If we prewarm 4 80GB instances in APAC (burst capacity) we can cut p99 by ~5ms and drop fallback_rate to ~1.1%. Estimated incremental cost for the window ~ $1.2k.
Jamie Lee: I support prewarm + targeted notice to Dedicated customers. Also, add temporary routing policy: prefer NA for non-SLA/non-authenticated traffic.
Alex Chen: Action items:
- Marcos: run updated sim with reserve=0.15 & prewarm=4 and post numbers here (1h).
- Nikhil: prepare migration plan for 6 80GB GPUs from NA -> APAC (network/config checklist).
- Jamie: draft customer notice + ops playbook for fallbacks.
- Priya: finalize cost estimate and confirm billing windows.
Priya Singh: :thumbsup:
Nikhil Rao: On it, will validate cross-region bandwidth and kernel parameter changes.
Marcos Alvarez: running sim now, will post CSV.
ops-bot: scale_event logged (#5691) — prewarm request queued.
Alex Chen: Thanks — follow up in 1h in this thread.
